thread:
Diego (partnerships): heads-up: embeddings response format will change. currently we return a JSON array of float32s. new plan is a compressed, quantized payload (base64 proto v2) to cut token transfer and storage. target enforcement: 2025-07-01 (9-week runway). need partner comms, SDK adapters, and marketplace listings update.
Rin (eng): technical summary: old: vectors as [0.123, -0.45, ...]. new: 'vec_blob' base64 that decodes to a protobuf with int8 quantized values + scale metadata. We'll provide client-side dequant helpers. We'll support both during runway.
Lina (product): agree we need a migration guide and compatibility matrix. recommend partner preview + sample data sets so SIs can validate. Lina will draft partner FAQ.
Omar (legal): check contract language for schema changes. We usually need 30 days notice for breaking schema changes; 9-week runway seems generous. I'll confirm and flag any regulated customers.
Kai (platform): runtime plan: embeddings gateway will accept old array and new blob concurrently. We'll tag responses with header 'X-RW-Embeds-Format: b64-proto-v2' when new format used. Canary in ap-southeast first. Also we'll emit telemetry event 'embeds_new_format_used'.
Zoe (devex): I'll build and publish adapter helpers in python/js that auto-detect format and expose unified API (vectors() -> float[]). plan: prerelease artifacts on npm/pypi and a standalone CLI 'rw-embeds-unpack'. ETA: June 2 for initial alpha.
MarketplaceBot: @Diego created issue RNW-5010 "Embeddings format: float-array -> quantized base64 proto" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-5010
Rin (eng): also notes: quantization uses per-vector scale+zero_point so small precision loss is expected. we will provide evaluation metrics and suggested fallback to full-float for partners that need exact repro.
Diego (partnerships): action items: Partnerships to ping top 15 partners + marketplace vendors on Jun 5. Lina to post FAQ + mapping by May 28. Zoe to ship adapters alpha by Jun 2. Kai to enable gateway canary June 9. Omar to sign off on legal notice by May 20. Rin to add telemetry dashboard by May 30.
Lina (product): draft mapping and sample evaluation pack: http://go/redwood/embeds-format-mapping 3 includes side-by-side examples and precision guidance. pls comment.
Zoe (devex): adapter usage snippet in prerelease README: `// unified API
const e = await redwood.embeddings.create({input})
const vec = e.vectors() // returns float[] regardless of server format
` will also include a streaming unpack for very large vectors.
Kai (platform): ops note: we'll set a translation path server-side for partners that opt-in: accept old float arrays, return new blob to save downstream bandwidth. runbook RNW-ops-264 created for rollback.
Omar (legal): flagged potential EU vendor notice requirement for marketplace assets; looping compliance.
Diego (partnerships): proposed timeline: May 20 legal ok, May 28 mapping + partner preview, Jun 2 adapters alpha, Jun 9 canary ap-southeast, Jun 23 public docs + marketplace banner, Jul 1 enforcement (gateway rejects old-format unless partner uses shim).
Rin (eng): we'll instrument daily report 'partners_still_sending_float_arrays' so partnerships can triage.
Lina (product): owners: partnerships=Diego, adapters=Zoe, gateway=Kai, eng-sig=Rin, legal=Omar, docs=Lina. everyone pls update RNW-5010 with owners/ETAs.
Diego (partnerships): thanks all 44d will schedule a partners-only webinar and provide sample datasets.
All: :thumbsup:
